drg.description: Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy without CC/MCC

timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. 82-year-old female admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.75, creatinine 0.86, hemoglobin 12.1, platelets 200, sodium 140, wbc 6.2; vitals dbp 73-78, heart_rate 84-89, map 93-97, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 14-15, sbp 131-138, spo2 95-97, temp 37-37.2
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Hypertension.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.87, hemoglobin 11.9, platelets 209, sodium 140, wbc 6.4; vitals dbp 74-78, heart_rate 84-88, map 94-98, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 14-16, sbp 133-138, spo2 95-97, temp 37-37.2
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Hypertension. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 82-year-old female, length of stay 3 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Hypertension. Follow up with primary care in one week. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed.
